intent: One inspector section: a 40px header (title + right-actions) over its content. The composable unit you stack inside Inspector; UI3 sections do not collapse — they appear and disappear by content presence.
use_when: Composing an inspector from titled groups of fields.
A section that should opt into a named region landmark.
dont_use_when: You need the whole rail — use Inspector.
A collapsible disclosure tree — this section has no chevron by design.

slots.children: The section body — field rows, controls, stacks.

a11y.role: region + aria-labelledby when landmark; otherwise a plain titled group.
a11y.header: 40px; the title labels the section (and becomes a button when onHeaderClick is set).
